WHERE THIS SITS

Voice, then Mail (the existing Continue with Google step, unchanged), then these four.

Sorting starts the moment Gmail connects. The first sync takes a minute or two, so there is real work to watch rather than a spinner.

Not now on screen 2 finishes setup. The run stays available from Mail, so skipping costs nothing.

Names and numbers on these boards are made up.

AUTOMATED MAIL: OPTION A

Counted and set aside silently. Never read, never sent, never raised as a question, and left unread.

The only place it appears is a count: on screen 1 while sorting, and on the receipt at the end, so you know it was seen and not forgotten.

WHAT MAKES SCREEN 3 REAL

- One request per person, so the progress is true: 3 of 9 is three people actually read, not a guess at a percentage.
- The model writes one fact per line, so each card can appear the moment its line is finished. The dashed card is the line being written.
- The cost ticks from what each finished request actually reports, not from the estimate.
- Stop keeps every fact that came back. The receipt is written per person as they are sent, so a stopped run still says exactly what left.

Tested against a made-up mailbox, never yours.

PERSONAL MAILBOX, SO NO SPLIT

No thing or you tag on the cards, and no destination under each one. For a personal mailbox every fact goes to one place, so it is said once in the footer instead of repeated on every card.

Clients, and choosing a space per fact, come back when a business mailbox is connected.

LEFT OUT ON PURPOSE

Only headers and signatures is not offered in onboarding. It is still on the Read your mail tab for later runs.

The 5 waiting facts are not lost if you click Go to Today: they wait in Inbox until you answer them.
